requirements.preflight: exact allowlist, eligibility, due state, input generation, watermark, fingerprint, MCD decision and bounded event IDs
requirements.execution: exclusive per-instance operation lock, quiescence probe, run ID, PID, lock path, processed input generation and fingerprint proof, plus bounded native effect evidence for successful processing
requirements.completion: exact post-state for every allowlisted object with source input identity separated from output fingerprint; UNKNOWN on missing or contradictory evidence
requirements.retention: immutable receipt digest plus bounded preimage and execution evidence retained in the local SQLite store

transport: producer-owned local receipt; MCC ingestion is out of scope for this source change
